ranking.rule: A variable is left out of the ranking, and reported as one of Earth's limits, when the median of the target's cells lies outside the whole range of Earth's reference population in physical units.

reference_population.definition: Ice-free, water-free land with every used dimension present. Antarctica enters as exposed rock; the ice sheet is excluded from ranking.

null_test.statistic: minimum di_combined over the Earth sample

succeeds.label: Slope
succeeds.text: Gradients are like the target's: use the site for rover and crew mobility, traverse energy budgets and landing-slope checks.

succeeds.label: Relief over 5 to 10 km
succeeds.text: Local relief is like the target's: plan and rehearse short traverses and descent paths over the same ups and downs.

succeeds.label: Relief over 21 to 42 km
succeeds.text: Regional relief is like the target's: rehearse long traverses and line-of-sight communication across the same scale of hills and basins.

succeeds.label: Landform position (bowl or ridge)
succeeds.text: The site sits in the same kind of landform as the target (basin floor, slope or ridge): access routes and what can be seen from the ground behave alike.

succeeds.label: Open sky
succeeds.text: The same share of the sky is open: rehearse solar-power siting and antenna pointing under the same horizon.

succeeds.label: Silica (rock type)
succeeds.text: The rock is of the same bulk type as the target's (basalt-like or silica-rich): practise sampling, drilling and contact instruments on it. Composition is a weak variable; check the site's rock in the field.

succeeds.label: Iron oxide
succeeds.text: The ground is as iron-rich as the target's: practise spectrometer and resource-prospecting work on it. Composition is a weak variable; check the site's rock in the field.

fails.label: Seasonal swing (Mars only)
fails.text: The seasonal swing is different: long-stay planning from this site does not transfer.

beyond_earth.label: Temperature level
beyond_earth.text: No ground on Earth is this cold. Tests at the target's temperature need a chamber, not a field site.

beyond_earth.label: Day-night swing
beyond_earth.text: No ground on Earth swings this far between day and night. Earth's air and oceans damp it.

limits: Chance test: not significant, p = 0.196. Control (Atacama patch): passed, p = 0.000999. Ranking system: all_variables. The team named all_variables the main result on 14 November 2026; this file is the main result. The second view, earth_reachable_only, is in its own file. The index is a cell's mean distance to EVERY cell of the target, so it measures likeness to the region as a whole; the target's own spread is 1.6396 and an index above 1 is expected for a varied target. Read ranks, not index values. With this score a patch that is uniform inside scores lower than a varied one whatever Earth looks like, so p partly measures how uniform the target is. A best 1% exists for every target: it is an order, not a quality. Variables no Earth cell reaches are listed in run.ranking.out_of_range and DO rank in this file; they may carry most of the distance. Composition is a weak variable at both ends (a rock-class lookup on Earth, 60 km blocks on the Moon). Mars temperatures are modelled, not measured. One cell is 6 to 7 km across; nothing here describes boulders or soil. Every site is a partial analog: see earths_limits.
